protocol.common_information: Same full RTL/harness, specification, five initial properties and common case_0 evidence. No successful research28 predicate is supplied.
protocol.treatments: B/D receive only the first seed contract search witnesses; A/C do not. C/D enforce historical gate after proposal; A/B use visible current evidence only.
protocol.gate_feedback: One-call trial: gate is a decision treatment, not extra initial prompt evidence. Initial prompts A=C and B=D.
protocol.source_search_cost: Seed3113 contract arm: four queries,64 native executions,shared source setup. B/D share this acquisition physically; charge64 logical executions to each search arm and report shared physical cost separately.
protocol.fairness: Same model configuration and one-call cap; actual tokens and simulation cost may differ and are reported. No unspent-token padding.
protocol.history_audit: After all arms freeze, evaluate all on same historical+acquired evidence. Audit outcomes cannot affect acceptance or model inputs.
protocol.independent: Generate one shared fresh26-case batch only after all arms freeze. No adaptation or selection.
protocol.scope: Single model seed, one known FIFO repair task and artificial faults; retrospective case selection. Not multiseed model stability or original historical parent proof.
